full_text: The Meghalaya Prevention of Gambling Act, 1970 Act No.8 of 1970 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 1970 Act Number: 8 Enactment Date: 1970-10-25 Act Year: 1970 Short Title: The Meghalaya Prevention of Gambling Act, 1970 Act No.8 of 1970 Long Title: An Act to provide for the prevention of gambling and for matters connected therewith Ministry: Ministry of Law Department Department: Law Department Type: STATE Location: Meghalaya TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Penalty for owning, keeping or having charge of a common gaming house. Section 4. Penalty for assisting gambling. Section 5. Penalty for being found in common gaming house. Section 6. Power of Police Officer to enter and search. Section 7. Finding instruments of gaming in suspected houses to be evidence that they are common gaming houses. Section 8. Penalty for giving for stakes unnecessary Section 9. Destruction of instruments of gaming and payment of reward to informers. Section 10. Proof for playing for stakes unnecessary. Section 11. Gaming in public places. Section 12. Power of Police Officer to enter premises and arrest persons, printing, etc., matters relating to gambling. Section 13. Exemptions Section 14. Indemnity of witnesses. Section 15. Penalty for subsequent offence. Section 15A. Offences under sections 3 and 4 non bailable Section 16. Searches how to be made. Section 17. Protection of action taken Section 18. Recovery of fines. Section 19. Power to make rules. Section 20. Repeal of the Public Gambling Act, 1967 (Central Act 3 of 1867). Section 21. Amendment of Assam Amusements and Betting Tax Act, 1980 (Assam Act 6 of 1939).
